<refentry xml:id="yaf-exception.getprevious" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the previous exception</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Throwable</type><methodname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This method is inherited from the base <exceptionname>Throwable</exceptionname> hierarchy and returns the exception that was chained as the previous one, if any.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>Returns the previous <exceptionname>Throwable</exceptionname> if available, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
try {
    $previous = new RuntimeException("Failed to open view script", 1024);
    throw new Yaf_Exception(
        "Failed to dispatch the request",
        YAF_ERR_DISPATCH_FAILED,
        $previous
    );
} catch (Yaf_Exception $e) {
    var_dump($e->getCode());
    $prev = $e->getPrevious();
    var_dump(get_class($prev));
    var_dump($prev->getMessage());
    var_dump($prev->getCode());
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
int(514)
string(16) "RuntimeException"
string(26) "Failed to open view script"
int(1024)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Exception::__construct</methodname></member>
   <member><exceptionname>Yaf_Exception</exceptionname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.getnamespacepath" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the library path of a class</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>string</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>class_name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the library directory a class would be looked up in.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>class_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The class name whose library directory is requested.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The local library directory if the class belongs to a registered local namespace, otherwise the global library directory (falling back to the local one when the global one is not set).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app    = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

$loader->registerLocalNamespace("Models");
$loader->setLibraryPath("/usr/local/share/yaf/library", true);

/* "Models" is a registered local namespace */
echo $loader->getNamespacePath("Models_Product"), PHP_EOL;

/* other classes fall back to the global library directory */
echo $loader->getNamespacePath("Vendor_Payment"), PHP_EOL;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/var/www/shop/application/library
/usr/local/share/yaf/library
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::isLocalName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.import" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::import</refname>
<refpurpose>Load a PHP script</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>file</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Load a PHP script file once. If the file is not an absolute path, it is looked up under the local library directory.</simpara>
  <simpara>A file is only included once; calling <methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname> again with the same file returns &true; without re-including it.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>file</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The file to load.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success (including when the file was already loaded), or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initHelpers()
    {
        /* a relative path is looked up under the library
         * directory, i.e. APPLICATION_PATH/library/functions/format.php */
        Yaf_Loader::import("functions/format.php");
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title>A file is imported only once</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* an absolute path is used as-is */
Yaf_Loader::import("/var/www/shop/application/library/Legacy/csv_export.php");

/* importing the same file again does nothing and returns true */
var_dump(
    Yaf_Loader::import("/var/www/shop/application/library/Legacy/csv_export.php")
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::autoload</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.registerlocalnamespace" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</refname>
<refpurpose>Register local namespace</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Loader</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname>
   <methodparam><type class="union"><type>string</type><type>array</type></type><parameter>namespace</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>path</parameter><initializer>&null;</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Register a local namespace. Classes whose prefix belongs to a local namespace are looked up under the given path (or the local library directory when no path is given) instead of the global one.</simpara>
  <simpara>This lets you place your own classes into the local library directory, while shared classes live in the global library directory (see the <literal>yaf.library</literal> ini setting).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>namespace</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>A namespace prefix string, or an array of prefix/path pairs (when the value is a path string) or prefix strings.</simpara>
<simpara>A prefix only matches at an underscore or backslash boundary: registering <literal>Models</literal> makes <literal>Models_User</literal> and <literal>Models</literal> itself local, but not <literal>ModelsUser</literal>. A leading backslash is ignored, and a class name written with backslashes is looked up as if they were underscores.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The directory to look up the namespace in. If not given, the local library directory is used.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the loader instance itself on success, or &false; if an invalid parameter is provided.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initLoader()
    {
        $loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

        /* Models_User is now looked up in
         * APPLICATION_PATH/library/Models/User.php */
        $loader->registerLocalNamespace("Models");

        /* register several prefixes at once, each with its
         * own lookup directory */
        $loader->registerLocalNamespace(array(
            "Services" => APPLICATION_PATH . "/services",
            "Vendor"   => APPLICATION_PATH . "/vendor",
        ));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::clearLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::isLocalName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>

    <term><parameter>path</parameter></term>

 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.dispatchloopshutdown" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook after dispatch loop</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered once, after the dispatch loop has finished and all actions have been executed, but before the response is sent to the client. It is usually used for logging or cleanup.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AccessLogPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function dispatchLoopShutdown(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* last hook before the response is sent: write an
         * access log entry */
        error_log(sprintf(
            "[%s] %s dispatched to %s/%s",
            date("c"),
            $request->getRequestUri(),
            $request->getControllerName(),
            $request->getActionName()
        ));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new AccessLogPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.dispatchloopstartup" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before dispatch loop</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered once, right before the dispatch loop starts and the view engine is initialized.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class BenchmarkPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function dispatchLoopStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* the view engine is not initialized yet, so this hook is a
         * good place to start request-wide bookkeeping */
        Yaf_Registry::set("request_start", microtime(true));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new BenchmarkPlugin());
    }
}
?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.postdispatch" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook after each dispatch</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered after each dispatch iteration finishes, i.e. after the action has been executed. Like <methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname>, it may be called more than once per request.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class BenchmarkPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function postDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* the action has been executed: append some debug
         * information to the response body */
        $elapsed = microtime(true) - Yaf_Registry::get("request_start");
        $response->appendBody(sprintf(
            "\n<!-- rendered in %.3f seconds -->",
            $elapsed
        ));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new BenchmarkPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.predispatch" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before each dispatch</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered before each dispatch iteration in the dispatch loop. A dispatch loop may run several iterations, so this hook may be called more than once per request.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class LayoutPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* pick the template directory based on the module, right
         * before the action is dispatched */
        $view = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getView();
        if ($request->getModuleName() == "Admin") {
            $view->setScriptPath(APPLICATION_PATH . "/modules/admin/views");
        }
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new LayoutPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.preresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before the response is sent</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is intended to be triggered before the response is sent to the client.</simpara>
  <warning>
   <simpara>As of this version this hook is never called: it is registered on <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname> but not wired into the dispatch flow. Overriding it has no effect.</simpara>
  </warning>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class MinifyPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preResponse(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* meant to minify the body right before it is sent; note
         * that, as of this version, this hook is never actually
         * called */
        $response->setBody(
            preg_replace("/>\s+</", "><", $response->getBody())
        );
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new MinifyPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerShutdown</methodname></member>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.routerstartup" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before routing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered right before the request is routed. It is the earliest hook in the dispatch flow, so it is usually used for URL rewriting or for routing decisions that must happen before <classname>Yaf_Router::route</classname> runs.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RewritePlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function routerStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* rewrite "/about" style URIs to "/page/about" before
         * routing runs */
        $uri = $request->getRequestUri();
        if (preg_match("#^/[a-z]+$#", $uri)) {
            $request->setRequestUri("/page" . $uri);
        }
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new RewritePlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::__construct</refname>
<refpurpose>Constructor of Yaf_Registry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier><methodname>Yaf_Registry::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>The constructor is private: <classname>Yaf_Registry</classname> implements the singleton pattern and cannot be instantiated directly. Use the static methods to read and write registry entries.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <simpara>
    The constructor is private, so direct instantiation is rejected:
   </simpara>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$registry = new Yaf_Registry();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught Error: Call to private Yaf_Registry::__construct() from invalid context
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title>Using <classname>Yaf_Registry</classname> through its static methods</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
Yaf_Registry::set("version", Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig()->application->version);
var_dump(Yaf_Registry::get("version"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(7) "1.0.0.1"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname></member>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.del" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::del</refname>
<refpurpose>Remove an item from registry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Removes an entry from the registry. Removing a name that does not exist is silently accepted.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Always returns &true;.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

 <refsect1 role="parameters">

<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.has" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::has</refname>
<refpurpose>Check whether an item exists</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether a value exists in the registry.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if an entry with the given name exists, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initRedis(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        /* skip the work if a previous bootstrap pass already did it */
        if (Yaf_Registry::has("redis")) {
            return;
        }

        $config = Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig()->redis;

        $redis = new Redis();
        $redis->connect($config->host, $config->port);

        Yaf_Registry::set("redis", $redis);
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.set" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::set</refname>
<refpurpose>Add an item into registry</refpurpose>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Stores a value in the registry. Setting an already existing name overwrites its previous value.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to store; it may be of any type, including objects.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initRedis(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $config = Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig()->redis;

        $redis = new Redis();
        $redis->connect($config->host, $config->port);

        /* the connection is now available to the whole application */
        Yaf_Registry::set("redis", $redis);
    }
}
?>
]]>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.get" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</refname>

 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from the request. The search order is: request parameters set by <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname>, then POST, GET, COOKIE, SERVER.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value if found, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it was provided, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class SearchController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        // Assuming the request is /search?keyword=yaf&page=2
        $keyword = $request->get("keyword");
        $page    = (int) $request->get("page", 1);
        $sort    = $request->get("sort", "relevance");

        var_dump($keyword, $page, $sort);
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>

int(2)

]]>

<refpurpose>Fetch a COOKIE variable</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getCookie</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from $_COOKIE.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name. If omitted, the whole array is returned.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The cookie value, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it is not set.</simpara>

   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class UserController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function profileAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        $theme     = $request->getCookie("theme", "light");
        $sessionId = $request->getCookie("sid");

        var_dump($theme, $sessionId);
    }
}
?>]]>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getparam" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve a parameter</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a parameter (a named routing/action parameter) from the request.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The parameter name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the parameter is not set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The parameter value, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it was provided, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function viewAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        // Assuming the request is /product/view/id/17
        $id       = (int) $request->getParam("id");
        $referrer = $request->getParam("referrer", "direct");

        var_dump($id, $referrer);
    }

?>]]>

 <refsect1 role="description">

  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getPost</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from $_POST.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name. If omitted, the whole array is returned.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>

<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>

<?php
class LoginController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract

  </methodsynopsis>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">

   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isDispatched</methodname>

  </methodsynopsis>

  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</refname>
<refpurpose>Determine if the request has been routed</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Determine whether the request has been routed.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the request has been routed, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        // Skip if another router already routed this request
        if ($request->isRouted()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api/")) {
            $request->setControllerName("Api")
                    ->setActionName("handle");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.isxmlhttprequest" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isXmlHttpRequest</refname>
<refpurpose>Determine if the request is an Ajax request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isXmlHttpRequest</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether the request is an Ajax request by inspecting the HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH request header.</simpara>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    <classname>Yaf_Request_Simple</classname> overrides this method and always
    returns &false;, since command-line requests are never Ajax requests.
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the request is an Ajax request (the <literal>X-Requested-With</literal> header equals <literal>XMLHttpRequest</literal>), &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isXmlHttpRequest</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function viewAction()
    {
        // Assuming the request carries "X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest"
        if ($this->getRequest()->isXmlHttpRequest()) {
            $this->getResponse()
                 ->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
                 ->setBody(json_encode(["id" => 17, "name" => "Yaf in Action"]));
            return false;
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
{"id":17,"name":"Yaf in Action"}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>

   set action name to request, this is usually used by custom router to set route result action name.

  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>

   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>format_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      this is introduced in Yaf 3.2.0, by default Yaf will format the name into lower case style,
      if this is set to &false; , Yaf will set the original name to request.
     </para>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setbaseuri" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set base URI</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>uir</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Set base URI, base URI is used when doing routing, in routing phase request
   URI is used to route a request,  while base URI is used to skip the
   leading part(base URI) of request URI.

   That is, if comes a request with request URI a/b/c, then if you set base
   URI to "a/b", only "/c" will be used in routing phase.
   <note>
    <simpara>
     generally, you don't need to set this, Yaf will determine it automatically.
    </simpara>
   </note>
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>uir</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
       base URI
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>Returns the request object itself on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("GET", "Index", "Product", "View");

// The application lives under /myapp,
// requests come in as /myapp/product/view
$request->setBaseUri("/myapp");
$request->setRequestUri("/myapp/product/view");

var_dump($request->getBaseUri());
var_dump($request->getRequestUri());
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(6) "/myapp"
string(19) "/myapp/product/view"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getBaseUri</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getRequestUri</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setcontrollername" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set controller name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>format_name</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    set controller name to request, this is usually used by custom router to set route result controller name.
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>controller</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      &string;, controller name, this should be in camel style, like "Index" or "Foo_Bar" 
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>format_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      this is introduced in Yaf 3.2.0, by default Yaf will format the name into camel mode,
      if this is set to &false; , Yaf will set the original name to request.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the request object itself on success, or &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RestRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api")) {
            // Names are formatted to camel style by default,
            // so "order_item" becomes "Order_Item"
            $request->setControllerName("order_item")
                    ->setActionName("list");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getControllerName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setdispatched" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</refname>
<refpurpose>Mark the request as dispatched</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>final</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Mark the request as dispatched</simpara>
  <simpara>This is called by the dispatcher after an action is executed; it stops the dispatch loop. It can be called manually, e.g. to skip the remaining dispatch iterations.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The state to set. Defaults to &true;.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AuthPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        if (empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
            // Skip the requested action and redirect to the login page
            $request->setDispatched();
            $response->setRedirect("/account/login");
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isDispatched</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setmodulename" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set module name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>format_name</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    set module name to request, this is usually used by custom router to set route result module name.
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>module</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      &string; module name, it should be in camel style, like "Index" or "Foo_Bar"   
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>format_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      this is introduced in Yaf 3.2.0, by default Yaf will format the name into camel mode,
      if this is set to &false; , Yaf will set the original name to request.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the request object itself on success, or &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AdminRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        // Serve everything under /admin from the Admin module
        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/admin")) {
            $request->setModuleName("Admin")
                    ->setControllerName("Dashboard")
                    ->setActionName("index");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getModuleName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setparam" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</refname>
<refpurpose>Set a parameter to the request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Set a parameter to the request, which can be retrieved by <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>.</simpara>
  <simpara>If called with a single array argument, every key/value pair is set as a parameter.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The parameter name, or an array of key/value pairs.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The parameter value. Required unless <parameter>name</parameter> is an array.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        $request->setParam("referrer", "newsletter");
        $request->setParam(["source" => "email", "campaign" => "spring"]);

        var_dump($request->getParam("referrer"));
        var_dump($request->getParams());
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(10) "newsletter"
array(3) {
  ["referrer"]=>
  string(10) "newsletter"
  ["source"]=>
  string(5) "email"
  ["campaign"]=>
  string(6) "spring"
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParams</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::clearParams</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setrequesturi" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</refname>
<refpurpose>Set the request URI</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>uri</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Set the request URI, overriding the one detected from the environment.</simpara>
  <simpara>This is useful when dispatching manually, e.g. in tests, with a URI that differs from the real one.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>uri</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The request URI to set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI", "Index", "Index", "Index");

// Dispatch manually against a URI that differs from the real one
$request->setRequestUri("/product/view/id/17");

var_dump($request->getRequestUri());
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(19) "/product/view/id/17"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</methodname></member>

  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setrouted" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</refname>
<refpurpose>Mark the request as routed</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>final</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Mark the request as routed</simpara>
  <simpara>This is called by the router once routing has succeeded. Calling it manually can prevent custom routers from being run afterwards.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The state to set. Defaults to &true;.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        if (0 !== strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api/")) {
            return false;
        }

        $request->setControllerName("Api")
                ->setActionName("handle");

        // Prevent routers registered after this one from running
        $request->setRouted();

        return true;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::route</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-http.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Http::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Constructor of Yaf_Request_Http</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Request_Http::__construct</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>request_uri</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>base_uri</parameter></methodparam>
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <para>

  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Http::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Build a http request explicitly with an URI and a base URI.
 *
 * If the request URI is omitted, it is retrieved from the usual
 * $_SERVER variables ($_SERVER["PATH_INFO"], $_SERVER["REQUEST_URI"], ...).
 */
$request = new Yaf_Request_Http("/product/detail/id/10", "/product");

 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</refname>
<refpurpose>Discard all existing response bodies</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>false</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>key</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Discard all existing response bodies.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>key</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The content key. If specified, only that content block is cleared; otherwise, all content blocks are cleared.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the response object itself on success, or &null; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $response = $this->getResponse();

        $response->setBody("Hello", "intro");
        $response->setBody("World");

        $response->clearBody("intro"); // drop only the "intro" block
        var_dump($response->getBody(null));

        $response->clearBody(); // drop every body block
        var_dump($response->getBody(null));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(1) {
  ["content"]=>
  string(5) "World"
}
array(0) {
}]]>
   </screen>
  </example>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Construct a response</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Construct a response object. The constructor takes no arguments; the
   concrete subclasses like <classname>Yaf_Response_Http</classname> and
   <classname>Yaf_Response_Cli</classname> initialize their own defaults
   (an HTTP response starts with the <literal>200</literal> response code,
   for example).
  </simpara>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    Usually a response object does not need to be constructed manually:
    <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname> returns the one
    created by the dispatcher.
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   No value is returned.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* usually there is no need to construct a response manually:
 * the dispatcher creates one and hands it out */
$response = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getResponse();

/* constructing directly is mostly useful in tests */
$response = new Yaf_Response_Http();
$response->setBody("Hello World");

echo $response;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Hello World]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::response</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-interface.assemble" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</refname>
  <refpurpose>Assemble a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>abstract</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>string</type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>info</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>array</type><parameter>query</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   this method returns a url according to the argument info, and append
   query strings to the url according to the argument query.
  </para>
  <para>
   a route should implement this method according to its own route rules, and
   do a reverse progress.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>info</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
     
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>

   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>query</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>

     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RewriteRoute implements Yaf_Route_Interface {

    private $_match;
    private $_route;

    public function __construct(string $match, array $route) {
        $this->_match = $match;
        $this->_route = $route;
    }

    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request): bool {
        if (!preg_match($this->_match, $request->getRequestUri(), $matches)) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($this->_route as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value) && ':' === $value[0]) {
                $value = $matches[substr($value, 1)];
            }
            $request->setParam($key, $value);
        }
        $request->setRouted();

        return true;
    }

    /* reverse the route rules back into a URL */
    public function assemble(array $info, ?array $query = null): string {
        $url = "/product";
        if (isset($info[':name'])) {
            $url .= "/" . $info[':name'];
        }

        if (!empty($query)) {
            $url .= "?" . http_build_query($query);
        }

        return $url;
    }
}

$router = new Yaf_Router();
$router->addRoute("custom",
    new RewriteRoute("#^/product#", array("controller" => "product"))
);

var_dump($router->getRoute("custom")->assemble(
    array(':name' => 'book'),
    array('page' => 2)
));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(20) "/product/book?page=2"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    <methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</methodname> is the only method
    that a custom route should implement.
    <note>
     <simpara>
      since of 2.3.0, there is another method should also be implemented,
      see <methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </note>
  </para>
  <para>
    if this method return &true;, then the route process will be end. otherwise,
    <classname>Yaf_Router</classname> will call next route in the route stack
    to route request.
  </para>

  <para>
    This method would set the route result to the parameter request, by
    calling <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname>,
    <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname> and
    <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname>.
   </para>

   <para>
    This method should also call
    <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname> to make the
    request routed at last.
   </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
       A <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiRoute implements Yaf_Route_Interface {

    private $_prefix;

    public function __construct(string $prefix) {
        $this->_prefix = $prefix;
    }

    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request): bool {
        $uri = $request->getRequestUri();
        if (0 !== strpos($uri, $this->_prefix)) {
            /* not our business, let the router try the next route */
            return false;
        }

        /* parse the URI "/api/user/list" into controller/action */
        $segments = explode("/", ltrim(substr($uri, strlen($this->_prefix)), "/"));
        $controller = isset($segments[0]) ? ucfirst($segments[0]) : NULL;
        $action = isset($segments[1]) ? $segments[1] : NULL;

        if (empty($controller)) {
            return false;
        }

        $request->setModuleName("index");
        $request->setControllerName($controller);
        $request->setActionName($action);
        $request->setRouted(); /* the route process ends here */

        return true;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, ?array $query = null): string {
        $uri = $this->_prefix . "/" . strtolower($info[':c']);
        if (isset($info[':a'])) {
            $uri .= "/" . $info[':a'];
        }

        if (!empty($query)) {
            $uri .= "?" . http_build_query($query);
        }

        return $uri;
    }
}

/**
 * register the custom route
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute("api", new ApiRoute("/api"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/* http://yourdomain.com/api/user/list
 * routes to the following values:
 */
array(
  "module"     => "index",
  "controller" => "User",
  "action"     => "list",
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::addRoute</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-map.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Route_Map::__construct</refname>
<refpurpose>Construct a map route</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::__construct</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>controller_prefer</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>delimiter</parameter><initializer>''</initializer></methodparam>
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>Construct a map route. A map route maps the whole URI to a controller name or an action name.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>controller_prefer</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>Whether to map the URI to a controller name. If &false;, the URI is mapped to an action name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>delimiter</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The delimiter used to separate the mapped name from the request parameters in the URI. If it occurs as a path segment preceded by a slash, everything after it is parsed as request parameters instead of being part of the mapped name. If empty, no such splitting happens during routing.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;

<![CDATA[

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-map.route" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</refname>
<refpurpose>Route a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Route the request by mapping the whole URI to a controller name or an action name: the path segments of the URI are joined with underscores to form the name.</simpara>
  <simpara>When the route was constructed with the controller prefer flag on, the result is set as the controller name, otherwise as the action name.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance to route.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Always returns &true;. Note that the map route claims the request even when the URI is empty, in which case no name is set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI");
$request->setRequestUri("/product/foo/bar");

$route = new Yaf_Route_Map();
var_dump($route->route($request));
var_dump($request->getActionName());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
string(15) "product_foo_bar"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI");
$request->setRequestUri("/user/list/_/foo/22");

$route = new Yaf_Route_Map(true, "_");
var_dump($route->route($request));
var_dump($request->getControllerName());
var_dump($request->getParam("foo"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
string(9) "User_List"
string(2) "22"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-regex.route" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Route_Regex::route</refname>
<refpurpose>Route a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::route</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Route the request with a regular expression: the URI is matched against the pattern given to the constructor, and the route result (the module, controller and action) is taken from the captured variables, mapped by the map parameter.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance to route.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the URI matches, &false; otherwise, which makes the router try the next route.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* assume the request URI is "/product/php-book" */
$request = new Yaf_Request_Http("/product/php-book");

$route = new Yaf_Route_Regex(
    "#^/product/([^/]+)/?$#", // match a URI leading "/product"
    array(
        'controller' => "product", // route to the product controller
    ),
    array(
        1 => "name", // $request->getParam("name") will be "php-book"
    )
);

var_dump($route->route($request));

var_dump($request->getControllerName());
var_dump($request->getParam("name"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
string(7) "product"
string(8) "php-book"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::__construct</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::match</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::assemble</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

                                ':tmpkey1' => 'tmpval1'
                        ),
                        array(
                                'tkey1' => 'tval1',
                                'tkey2' => 'tval2'
                             )
                        )
);

]]>

     <para>

       it doesn't match, <classname>Yaf_Route_Rewrite</classname> will return
       &false;.

      module/controller/action is the destination.
     </para>
     <para>
      Either of module/controller/action in this array is optional, if you don't assign a
      specific value, it will be routed to default.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>

   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Rewrite</classname> example</title>

<![CDATA[
<?php
   /**
    * Add a rewrite route to Yaf_Router route stack
    */
    Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute("name",
        new Yaf_Route_Rewrite(
           "/product/:name/:id/*", //match request uri leading "/product"
           array(
               'controller' => "product",  //route to product controller,
           ),
        )
    );
?>
]]>

<![CDATA[

  "module"     => "index", //(default)
  "action"     => "index", //(default)
)

/**
 * and request parameters:
 */
array(
  "name" => "foo",
  "id"   => 22,
  "foo"  => bar
)
]]>

<![CDATA[
    <?php

    * Add a rewrite route to Yaf_Router route stack by calling addconfig
    */
    $config = array(
        "name" => array(
           "type"  => "rewrite",        //Yaf_Route_Rewrite route
           "match" => "/user-list/:id", //match only /user/list/?/
           "route" => array(
               'controller' => "user",  //route to user controller,
               'action'     => "list",  //route to list action
